FINDING: app/auth.py:14 | security | high | `find_user` builds its SQL with an f-string from `name`, which allows SQL injection.
FINDING: app/auth.py:5 | security | high | `SECRET_KEY` is hardcoded in source, so anyone with repo access can forge tokens.
FINDING: app/files.py:10 | security | high | `export_report` joins the caller-supplied `filename` into the path unsanitized, so `../` or an absolute path writes outside `EXPORT_DIR`.
FINDING: app/orders.py:13 | logic | high | `apply_discount` uses `>` where the docstring says "$100.00 or more", so exactly 10_000 cents gets no discount.
FINDING: app/orders.py:23 | logic | high | Tax is computed on `subtotal` instead of the discounted amount, contrary to the docstring.
FINDING: app/inventory.py:10 | logic | high | The slice end `start + page_size - 1` returns only `page_size - 1` items per page, an off-by-one.
FINDING: tests/test_orders.py:19 | tests | high | `test_discount_at_threshold` only prints and has no assertion, so the `>` boundary bug goes uncaught.
FINDING: tests/test_inventory.py:7 | tests | high | `assert len(page) <= 10` is too loose, so the 9-item pages still pass. It should assert `== 10`.
FINDING: app/orders.py:61 | logic | medium | `place_order` ignores the return value of `reserve`, so an order can be created even when a reservation fails, for example with duplicate SKUs in the cart.
FINDING: app/auth.py:21 | security | medium | The password salt is the username, so it is predictable and not unique per user (same pattern at line 30).
FINDING: app/auth.py:35 | security | medium | `sign_token` signs only `user_id`, with no expiry or nonce, so tokens never expire and can be replayed.
FINDING: app/orders.py:37 | performance | medium | `dedupe_skus` checks membership against a list, which makes it O(n²). A companion set would fix this.
FINDING: app/orders.py:44 | performance | medium | `count_by_status` rescans every order once per status. A single counting pass would do the same work.
FINDING: tests/test_orders.py:25 | tests | medium | No test combines a discount with tax, so the tax-on-subtotal bug goes uncaught.
FINDING: tests/test_inventory.py:20 | tests | medium | The stock level after a successful `reserve` is never checked, so the decrement itself is untested.
FINDING: tests/test_auth_files.py:14 | tests | medium | `test_find_user` uses only a benign name, so the SQL injection goes uncaught.
FINDING: app/auth.py:9 | security | low | PBKDF2 runs only 100,000 iterations, below current recommendations for SHA-256.
FINDING: tests/test_auth_files.py:19 | tests | low | `test_sign_token_is_stable` would pass with any deterministic hash, so it cannot catch a broken signature.

I merged the duplicate reports for `tests/test_orders.py:19` and `tests/test_inventory.py:7`, which both bug-hunter and test-reviewer raised. I used the skill's format (category and severity added) instead of the shorter format you gave.
